purpose: Positive fixture of the released flat Session 50 (tag v0.14.5) that a Web Save Session wrote after it loaded a CLI Session saved with --conservation_color_scheme ten: the Ring colors scheme was no GUI setting there, so the Circular slice's draft keeps it as a preserved override, modes.circular.config.unmanagedConfigOverrides['objects.conservation.color_scheme'], and the Web filled every ring with a colour (#4e79a7, OV-3054). Load moves the scheme into the drawing's circularConservation.colorScheme (PD-OI-110; adoptPromotedPreservedOverrides in gbdraw/web/js/services/session-request.js) and, as the stored request names no ring colour (no diagramOptions.conservationColors), reads the #4e79a7 fill as no colour of the rings' own (D-38).
route: From the root of `git archive v0.14.5`: the CLI writes a Circular Session with three BLAST rings and --conservation_color_scheme ten; the v0.14.5 Web app loads it in Node and Save Session writes it.
